long_biography.plain_text:
OneCoin began in Sofia as a global multi-level-marketing business built around a purported cryptocurrency. Ruja Ignatova co-founded the company with Karl Sebastian Greenwood and served as its top leader. The operation sold educational packages carrying OneCoin tokens while promoting a private system that lacked the public blockchain associated with conventional cryptocurrencies. Investors worldwide sent billions of dollars to OneCoin accounts.

Ignatova travelled from Sofia to Athens on 25 October 2017 and has not been seen publicly since. A U.S. federal indictment charges her with wire fraud, securities fraud and related conspiracies; those accusations remain unresolved because she has not been tried. The FBI added her to its Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list in June 2022, and the U.S. State Department now offers a reward of up to $5 million for information leading to her arrest or conviction.
